from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "control/codex_supervisor"))

from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import build_request, build_result, TARGET_MODEL
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files, provenance_record
import experiment_gate as gate

def write_record(repo: Path, files: dict[str,str], record: dict) -> None:
    for name, pin in record["files"].items():
        p = repo / pin["ref"]
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(files[name], encoding="utf-8")

def astra_record(repo: Path, route: str) -> dict:
    prompt="review"
    final=json.dumps({"candidate_id":"X"})
    ih=hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()
    task={"task_id":"ASTRA-SMOKE","phase":"ASTRA_POSTBUILD","model_policy":"ASTRA_EXACT","campaign_id":"C","route_task_id":route,"prompt":prompt,"input_sha256":ih}
    worker={"model":"gpt-6-astra","model_selection":{"policy":"ASTRA_EXACT","selected_slug":"gpt-6-astra"},"command_flags":["exec","-m","gpt-6-astra"],"started_at":3.0}
    complete={"task_id":"ASTRA-SMOKE","input_sha256":ih,"thread_id":"astra-thread","final":final,"timestamp":4.0}
    events=[{"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"astra-thread"},{"type":"item.completed","item":{"type":"agent_message","text":final}},{"type":"turn.completed"}]
    texts={"TASK.json":json.dumps(task),"WORKER.json":json.dumps(worker),"COMPLETE.json":json.dumps(complete),"events.jsonl":"".join(json.dumps(e)+"\n" for e in events)}
    rec={"revoked":False,"files":{}}
    for name,text in texts.items():
        ref="astra/"+name
        p=repo/ref
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text,encoding="utf-8")
        rec["files"][name]={"ref":ref,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()}
    return rec

def main() -> int:
    route="SESSION-ROUTE-controller"
    overlay={"candidate_id":"X","governed_lifecycle":{"campaign_id":"C","route_task_id":route},"live_trading":False,"paid_actions":False,"wallet_actions":False}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        repo=Path(td)
        req=build_request(task_id="SOL-SMOKE",phase="SOL_BUILD",campaign_id="C",candidate_id="X",binding_sha256="a"*64,prompt="build",delivery_route_task_id=route,created_at_utc="2026-10-07T11:46:00Z")
        res=build_result(req,worker_route_task_id="SESSION-ROUTE-sol-worker",final=json.dumps({"candidate_id":"X"}),started_at_utc="2026-10-07T11:47:00Z",finished_at_utc="2026-10-07T11:48:00Z")
        files=normalized_run_files(req,res)
        sol_record=provenance_record("sol",files)
        write_record(repo,files,sol_record)
        _,sol_worker,_,sol_result=gate.model_record(repo,sol_record,overlay,"SOL_BUILD")
        assert sol_worker["model"] == TARGET_MODEL
        assert sol_worker["execution_layer"] == "DIRECT_SOL_CHAT"
        assert sol_result["candidate_id"] == "X"

        ar=astra_record(repo,route)
        _,astra_worker,_,astra_result=gate.model_record(repo,ar,overlay,"ASTRA_POSTBUILD")
        assert astra_worker["model"] == "gpt-6-astra"
        assert astra_result["candidate_id"] == "X"

        wp=repo/sol_record["files"]["WORKER.json"]["ref"]
        bad=json.loads(wp.read_text())
        bad["model"]="gpt-6-astra"
        wp.write_text(json.dumps(bad,sort_keys=True),encoding="utf-8")
        sol_record["files"]["WORKER.json"]["sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(wp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        try:
            gate.model_record(repo,sol_record,overlay,"SOL_BUILD")
        except gate.ExperimentGateError:
            pass
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("DIRECT_SOL_WRONG_MODEL_ACCEPTED")
    print("DIRECT_SOL_GATE_QUALIFY_R2=PASS")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
